# Homesrolo

> Homesrolo helps homeowners understand major home projects and keep a durable history of the work performed on a property. Public guides show the sources behind material facts. Home records remain private unless the homeowner chooses to share them.

## Roofing

- [Texas roofing center](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/): Cost, materials, contractor checks, insurance boundaries, and Dallas Fort Worth rules.
- [Repair or replace a roof](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/repair-or-replace/): Evidence that separates a durable repair from a complete roof replacement.
- [Roof replacement cost](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/cost/): Dallas market benchmarks and a line-by-line estimate comparison.
- [Roofing materials](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/materials/): Asphalt, impact-resistant, metal, tile, slate, composite, and the full roof assembly.
- [Contractor checklist](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/choose-a-contractor/): Documents to verify and 12 questions to ask before signing.
- [Dallas Fort Worth roofing](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/dfw/): North Texas weather, local rules, and project records.
- [Dallas roofing](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/dallas/): Dallas roofing permits, bids, and closeout records.
- [Fort Worth roofing](https://homesrolo.com/services/roofing/fort-worth/): Fort Worth permit triggers, wood repairs, and scope details.

## Roof Watch

- [Roof Watch](https://homesrolo.com/roof-watch/): Current program description, written limits, inspection scope, archival field photos, service area, and availability instructions.
- [Roof Watch homeowner guides](https://homesrolo.com/roof-watch/guides/): Sourced guidance for hail response, roof reports, North Texas heat, and ventilation.
- [The first 72 hours after hail](https://homesrolo.com/roof-watch/guides/hail-first-72-hours/): Safety, documentation, temporary protection, and prompt insurer notice, with Texas Department of Insurance sources.
- [What belongs in a roof inspection report](https://homesrolo.com/roof-watch/guides/roof-inspection-report/): A practical checklist for locations, observations, photographs, limits, and next steps.
- [What Texas heat does to a roof](https://homesrolo.com/roof-watch/guides/texas-heat-roof/): Heat, ventilation, attic, and roof-surface context with manufacturer and building-science sources.

## Important limits

- Roof Watch is a Homesrolo-coordinated program. An identified roofing professional performs the visit; current address coverage, the assigned professional, and written program limits are confirmed before scheduling.
- Roof Watch documents visible roof condition. It does not certify a roof, decide cause or insurance coverage, file or negotiate claims, or require the homeowner to award later work to the inspecting professional.
- Field photos on the program page were selected from the operator's archival roof-photo library. They are documentation examples, not Roof Watch findings about a particular home.
- Cost figures are dated market benchmarks, not quotes for a particular home.
- Permit rules and laws can change. The current source is linked from each guide.
- Homesrolo is built around the home and its project record, not a pay-to-rank contractor directory.
